purpose: Template for the owner-staged official evidence that resolves the blocked fields of the Romania 2016 Chamber of Deputies candidate. Copy to .tmp-data-refresh/political-candidate-romania/evidence/evidence.json, put each document file next to it, and fill the facts. The builder accepts a fact only if it cites a staged document whose SHA-256 matches and gives a locator (page, table, article). Nothing is fetched automatically.

documents_required.what: Official act setting the date of the 2016 parliamentary elections (Government decision published in Monitorul Oficial).

Official definition of the polling-station minutes (proces-verbal) fields for the Chamber of Deputies 2016 — the legal text or BEC/AEP decision that defines points a, a1–a3, b, b1–b3, c, d, e, f, g, and the postal-vote equivalents a, b, b1, b2, c, c1, c2, d, d1, d2.

BEC official final results of the Chamber of Deputies election 2016 (national totals: registered voters, voters, valid and invalid votes, turnout, votes and percentages per competitor), with its publication date or Monitorul Oficial reference.
Official allocation of Chamber seats to national-minority organisations under the special rule (BEC decision or final results annex).
Official total number of deputies elected in 2016 (validation of mandates or final results), separating ordinary list seats from national-minority seats.
Law 208/2015 as applicable in December 2016 (thresholds, constituency seat allocation, minority representation).
resolves: seat-allocation rules in the electoral-system note

documents_required.what: Official list of electoral competitors with their type (party, political alliance, national-minority organisation, independent).
